connectionTypes.verifiedByNote: SOURCED (official domain) — from DJB's own published Category-II (commercial/industrial) tariff table, but dated to the same 14/08/2015 order whose domestic figures we've since identified as likely superseded by newer domestic rates. No commercial-specific free allowance applies (Delhi's free-water scheme is domestic-only). The real commercial rate today is plausibly higher than shown here — treat this table as directionally correct (commercial runs 2-4x domestic per KL) rather than precisely current. Fixed charge uses the same unverified meter-size simplification as domestic; DJB's real commercial service charge also appears tier-based.

verifiedBy: SOURCED (secondary) — restructured from a 4-slab placeholder to DJB's real 3-slab domestic structure (0-20 / 21-30 / 31+ KL) after cross-checking two independent secondary sources that converged exactly on the 21-30 KL (₹26.36) and 31+ KL (₹43.93) rates. The entry-slab rate is less certain — sources ranged ₹4.39-5.27/KL for the same slab; ₹5.27 used as the more recently-dated figure. The 20 KL/month all-or-nothing free scheme and 60% sewerage charge were independently confirmed and unchanged from the prior placeholder. NOT modeled: DJB's real fixed charge appears to be a 'service charge' that scales by consumption tier (roughly ₹146-293/cycle per secondary sources), not by meter size as this file assumes — the meter-size-keyed fixedChargeByMeterSize values here remain an unverified simplification. See each connection type's own verifiedByNote for type-specific caveats. Pending a clean, single, dated primary-source tariff notification to fully resolve.
